notes: Operating lines, stations and track geometry © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), imported from route relations (simplified ~15 m). The Circle Line is shown complete (CCL6 Keppel – Cantonment – Prince Edward Road opened 12 Jul 2026). Upcoming lines (TEL Stage 5 and DTL3e opening 26 Dec 2026, DTL2 extension, Jurong Region Line, Cross Island Line, RTS Link) are hand-drawn through their announced stations; their alignments and unbuilt station positions are approximate. JRL Stage 2/3 and CRL Phase 3 have no official opening year and appear at the end of the timeline. Not shown: infill stations (Founders' Memorial, Brickland, JS2A), unopened Mount Pleasant and Marina South, Changi Airport Skytrain.
